poll_host.description: The hostname or IP address of the POP3/IMAP server to poll.

poll_proto.description: The protocol to use when polling the mail server (e.g., pop3, imap).

poll_user.description: The username for authenticating with the remote mail server.

poll_password.description: The password for authenticating with the remote mail server.

poll_local_user.description: The local Linux user account to deliver retrieved mail to.
